papers.title: Precision on Demand: Escalating Weight Bits at Uncertain Decoding Steps in a Small Local Model
papers.summary: A dynamic weight precision allocation strategy is proposed, utilizing low-bit quantization and uncertainty-based gating to selectively upgrade weight precision during LLM generation, thereby optimizing computational cost.

papers.title: SteerDistill: Quantizing LLM Agents via Closed-Loop Teacher Steering
papers.summary: Low-bit quantized LLM agents can recover much of their task success through closed-loop guidance from a full-precision teacher, followed by unassisted student training on corrected and reference turns.
